disease_state.evidence: Longitudinal metabolomic, metagenomic, and metaproteomic changes were measured in 27 healthy subjects supplemented with soy protein isolate (SPI, 40 g per day) for 5 days followed by GPs complexed to SPI (GP-SPI standardized to 5% GPs, 40 g per day) for 10 days.
